note: Provider catalogue: every number is cited to a RESEARCH_LOG id. Prices are integer micros of USD (1 USD = 1,000,000 micros). Values marked ESTIMATE are design defaults, not provider facts.

anthropic.worst_case_overhead_tokens_source: ESTIMATE (design default, owner-tunable): framing allowance added to the UTF-8 byte count that bounds the prompt tokens of one call (a token covers at least one byte). REQUIRES REVIEW (Phase 1): compare with the free token count in the pilot

retry.source: PR-09 (official SDK default: two retries; a 429 without retry-after is a spend cap); max_in_call_wait_ms is ESTIMATE

elevenlabs.character_count_source: PR-12 (every letter, number, punctuation mark and space; tags count). REQUIRES REVIEW (Phase 1): Devanagari code point vs grapheme counting, compare with the usage export in the pilot
elevenlabs.connect_timeout_source: ESTIMATE (design defaults for all three timeouts; owner-tunable)
elevenlabs.list_voices_source: PR-12 (page_size at most 100); max_pages is ESTIMATE

retry.source: PR-12 (429 rate_limit_exceeded / concurrent_limit_exceeded: back off and retry); counts and wait are ESTIMATE

elevenlabs.wav_sample_rates_source: PR-11 (output_format wav_<rate>). REQUIRES REVIEW (Phase 1): plan tier needed for 48 kHz WAV

forbidden_models.eleven_multilingual_v2: no Marathi (PR-04, PR-11); also the provider default model_id

elevenlabs.markup_delimiters_source: PR-11, PR-12 (audio tags such as [whispering] are square-bracketed and count as characters); the caller must escape these in script text
elevenlabs.pace_speed_source: empty until the owner's 3B listening test fixes one voice_settings.speed per TtsPace (PR-11 lists speed in voice_settings); required for every model with speed_control true
elevenlabs.emotion_audio_tags_source: empty until the owner's 3B listening test fixes one audio tag per TtsEmotion (ADR-008 REQUIRES REVIEW); empty means emotion_control NONE
elevenlabs.voice_settings_source: null: the voice's stored settings are used; owner sets stability / similarity_boost after the listening test

eleven_v4.pronunciation_dictionary_source: PR-11 (pronunciation_dictionary_locators is a request parameter; no per-model restriction is stated). REQUIRES REVIEW (Phase 1): confirm for each model

eleven_v4_turbo.source: PR-11, PR-12; REQUIRES REVIEW (Phase 1): character limit not documented

eleven_v3_conversational.source: PR-11, PR-12; REQUIRES REVIEW (Phase 1): character limit not documented
